style: Soft retro flat vector illustration: a dark base colour (#15261e), one accent colour (#d7f25a) and white, simple clean shapes, no text, no people, no hands.

subjects.electricite-electronique: A car battery, an alternator and a starter motor lying on a workbench with a digital multimeter beside them connected by red and black leads. Absolutely no hands, no arms, no gloves, no people.

hero: A local repair garage interior: a car on a lift and a second car with its hood open, a tire rack along the wall; through a high window, rolling Eastern Townships hills in the distance. Flat vector, DARK overall (#15261e), accent highlights (#d7f25a), white accents. Subject weighted to the right two thirds; the left third is plain dark background that fades smoothly (no hard edge, no panel, no frame). Interior only: no building exterior, no text, no signs, no logos, no license plates, no people, no hands, no numbers. All cars are generic invented designs: no recognizable real models, no brand grilles, no badges or emblems.
